title: selaginella porelloides
intro: Selaginella porelloides, commonly known as the resin fern or resin spore fern, is a species of plant belonging to the Selaginellaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, wounds, and skin problems. The health benefits of Selaginella porelloides include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include resins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
